title: US markets closed — Labor Day (falls inside the 2027-09-04 → 09-16 FOMC blackout, leaving the gate's first three calendar days with zero trading sessions)
source: NEWS: TWO INDUSTRY PRIMARIES, both fetched direct 2026-09-06. (1) nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200, 109,148 bytes) -- its holiday table, which states "All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028", gives the 2027 column verbatim as "Labor Day | Monday, September 6", a full closure, and lists no early close anywhere in September 2027. NOTE FOR THE FAMILY: this endpoint returned HTTP 200 to this runner today, where the sibling memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 entry recorded three consecutive 403s with three different user agents on 2026-09-05 -- the block is intermittent, not permanent, so the NYSE side of this entry is FETCHED rather than inherited. (2) sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule (HTTP 200, 298,772 bytes), whose 2027 US Holiday Recommendations panel -- read out of the page's own embedded payload, the method the sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 entry documented -- renders the entry as heading "Labor Day", date "Monday, September 6, 2027", note EMPTY, i.e. a full fixed-income close with NO recommended early close on the preceding Friday. The string "September 3, 2027" does not appear anywhere on that page. Independently reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Labor Day on the FIRST Monday in September, and the first Monday of September 2027 is 2027-09-06. Filed estimate on the same three counts the sibling closure entries labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 and presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 documented: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange's or a trade association's own holiday calendar, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and a proposal is always estimate by contract. The DATE is not in doubt -- the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Discovered during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). It is the only dated non-Fed item inside that blackout window, and the twin of the already-tracked labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07. WHY A CLOSED SESSION EARNS A ROW HERE: the gate opens at 12:00 a.m. ET Saturday 2027-09-04, so Saturday, Sunday and this Monday are its first three calendar days and they contain ZERO trading sessions -- the gate's first session is Tuesday 2027-09-07 and the whole window runs 8 sessions rather than the usual 9. THE LEDGER THAT DISCOVERED IT ALSO REFUSED TO BUILD ON IT, and that refusal is the point of this note: Labor Day falls inside 5 of the 21 September blackout gates derivable from the Board's own footnote rule applied to every parsed meeting 2007-2027 (2012, 2015, 2020, 2026, 2027), and an 8-session September gate is one of only two lengths September produces (8 -> 4 years, 9 -> 15 across 2007-2025). Both are routine, which is exactly what the memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 entry concluded about its own calendar first. WHAT DOES CARRY, AND IT IS A CONTRAST WITH THAT SIBLING: the preceding session, Friday 2027-09-03, is the last day any FOMC participant may speak before the gate falls, and unlike 2027-05-28 it is a FULL session in both markets -- SIFMA recommends no early close before Labor Day -- so the operative Fed deadline here is the 16:00 ET equity close, not a 14:00 ET rates close. That same session is also the August 2027 employment report by BLS's own reference-week rule (registered as FT-fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04-2 rather than filed, because all three bls.gov schedule endpoints returned 403 to this runner today). IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: a closed session moves nothing by itself and no house playbook is calendar-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped this session for 'holiday|labor day|closure|half-day|early close|blackout': zero hits in both). It widens caution and licenses nothing. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'sector', the same least-wrong choice every sibling closure entry documented. DUPLICATE CHECK RUN: the calendar carries a Labor Day entry for 2026 only, no canonical labor-day-market-closure-2027-09-06.json exists, and no competing proposal for this id exists under proposals/.
